pages.title: Symbiont Lining
pages.text: A living skin of helpful microbes grown to line a machine, repairing and renewing its catalysts as they work. Fitted to a machine, its catalysts wear 40% slower. One upgrade per machine. Made in the Ecosphere.
Made in $(item)Ecosphere$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Predator and Prey.
